name: Combat Utility Vibroblade
description: The Combat Utility Vibroblade (C.U.V) was a vibroblade created by Shistavanen survivalists from the planet Uvena Prime. It was created to contain every conceivable tool necessary to survive in battle or in the wilderness. Each C.U.V was a custom configuration, and could contain a fire starter, a hydrospanner, or a water contaminant detector.
